d: Miles beneath the surface of the world's oceans lie enigmas that challenge modern science and history. Join host Jeremy Wade as marine researchers and deep-sea divers plunge into crushing depths where strange global finds expose ocean mysteries that have confounded experts for generations. From unexplored oceanic trenches to uncharted continental shelves, relentless global expeditions fuel deep sea discovery using cutting-edge sonar mapping and manned submersibles. Journey across international waters where haunting ruins and bizarre global wrecks reveal deep mysteries buried under…
